Miniature Horse Charlie has a severe problem with his mouth that Chris needs to investigate, but getting access to the tiny creatures teeth becomes a near impossible task.

A Melbourne principal's staffy Juno is fading fast. Chris brings her to Sydney for a CT scan revealing a condition so rare only 20 cases exist worldwide—her blood vessels are all mixed up and she needs high-risk surgery.

Ziggy the cat has a big problem - he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats' deteriorating health is not compromised further.

Chris heads to Cornwall, UK. He's flat-out treating a dairy calf needing urgent surgery, a prize-winning duck with a torn foot, and a Siberian eagle owl with a bung eye, and giving two Atlantic grey seals the all-clear for release.

In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3-day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumor.
Chris heads to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital, where sick and injured falcons are treated like royalty.

A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.
Chris's trip has an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters.

Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anesthetized so Chris can investigate.

Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. Amari needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

Travel to the Cook Islands as Chris helps out at a vet clinic where ill and injured pets abound. Princess needs help following a hit and run, and Mani the duck has lost a fight. A goat and a wolfhound round out the medical menagerie.
Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much-loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing.

Chris makes a special trip to Karara to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

Chris travels to Edgars Mission, where he is faced with Ben Hall, a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

Parker battles Tony in an intense showdown for the year's top gold haul. Rick grinds at Lightning Creek and expands his operation to save his season.
How do they make the tank piercing super bullet? Plus, how do they forge the infamous torture weapon, the dentist's drill?

Josh Gates investigates three aquatic mysteries: the Kraken, Lake Lanier and Atlantis. From terrifying sailor lore, to a deadly lake's dark past, and a lost city beneath the sea, he searches for evidence behind legends shaped by fear, myth and history.
A game changing piece of equipment leads the Ferals to their biggest nugget haul of the season. Plus, Shane and Russell battle unseasonal weather.
The Poseidon crew members are slowed down by fierce storms. Jacqui and Andrew encounter a deadly insect, while the Gold Timers try to fix their dry blower.

Marcus and Dale find a huge gold nugget; the Gold Timers uncover their biggest gold haul ever; Shane and Russell overwork their sluice.
The Poseidon Crew recruits a 14-year-old worker to help speed up its operation. Meanwhile, the Gold Timers are slowed down by a freak dust storm.

p.t: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy And Juan
p.d: A dry claim sitting in the epicentre of a famous BC gold rush tests Freddy and Juan's limits with an overcomplicated wash plant dubbed The Octopus.
Paul Mackie and his expert team must haul a crew of first-time gold miners out of an epic three-year gold drought before their operation and family legacy ends in ruin.
Paul Mackie and his team of experts travel to the unforgiving Western Australian Pilbara to help an Indigenous family gold mine save itself from financial disaster.
Rick races to finish the build of new washplant, Monster Red, but faces shutdown when forest fires cut off his fuel supplies. Disaster hits Big Red for Brennan.
Rick races to get Monster Red running. A dangerous storm spells disaster for Parker's operation and the Beets kids unite to kick-start another claim.
Tensions rise when Parker introduces a new crew member and a radical plan. The Beets family run an important test on daughter Monica's Hunker Creek claim.
Rick's season is jeopardised when an engineering disaster shuts him down. Parker ploughs big money into a new claim and Tony gets a third operation running.

p.t: Diners,Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation
p.d: Guy's picking up gourmet tacos in Phoenix, a signature mac cheesy pizza in Boston, and out-of-bounds oxtails in Texas.
In Atlanta, two pals are serving up patty melt empanadas. There's a bakery in LA plating khachapuri, and a Japanese joint is dishing out BBQ pork bao.

Foodie Casey Webb travels to the Jersey Shore where he eats through a six-pound lobster stuffed with crabmeat before embarking on the spicy Indian pizza challenge that requires contestants to sign a liability waiver.

The shop is gearing up for the annual SEMA Show in Las Vegas, and this year Dave is bringing seven cars. Once the cars are readied, placed in their booths, and the show is running, the guys get a chance to check out some of the new builds.
The El Mirage land speed race is coming and we couldn't be more excited! Ready? Not exactly. The Roadster needs a few projects completed to pass tech.

Twenty years back, Bill started Ekstensive Metalworks by specializing in lifting, lowering and everything in between. Fast forward to today, and he's still being put to the test with a 1928 Ford Rat Rod, a 1942 Ford pickup and a 1975 C10.
The VW project hits the paint booth. The crew works to cross the finish line with a new motor, custom suspension, and a complete interior overhaul.
The brothers stance and drop a Cummins diesel into an '85 Dodge and turn it into a Sunday shredder in classic pro street style.

Kye and his team try to hold onto their early lead by going rounds in Brainerd, MN, while Team Dave makes a change to his roster, bringing in Dominator. Newcomer Damon keeps surprising the competition, and Kye makes it clear he's done being runner-up.

p.t: Street Outlaws: Farmtruck And AZN Down Under
p.d: A nitrous shortage threatens to stall Farmtruck and AZN's Australian fishing trip.
When Doughboy's new Impala is finally ready to start up for the first time, the whole family gathers to celebrate.
JJ and the crew head west to meet with some Arizona racers led by old acquaintance Mary. But the trip is off to a bad start when a truck breaks in transit.

Looking into what happens if a Cummins diesel engine is put into a 2004 Lamborghini Gallardo; a customer wants Wide Open Garage to turn an old, rusted Chevy truck into a lifted, all-terrain truck on huge 74-inch tires.

The TAPS team travels to a Civil War fort in Maine in order to explore claims of an evil presence that resides within its walls, and they later head to a home in North Carolina to investigate the sounds and physical contact that plague a family.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor.
Ghost Hunters, Tapsheads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House.

For the first time ever, TAPS travels to Hawaii to explore one of America's most sacred settings, Pearl Harbor. They are joined in their investigation of the Pacific Aviation Museum by Destination Truth's Josh Gates.
We pick were we last left off, in Hawaii, for the reveal. Jason and Grant were called back for a very important personal case, the Reid House, in Rhode Island, to help a scared 4 year old.

The TAPS team has been called out to investigate Hill View Manor in New Castle, Pennsylvania. Once a nursing facility, this now abandoned building is fraught with paranormal activity that allegedly stems from the violent deaths of former patients.

TAPS is summoned to Newport, R.I., to investigate Seaview Terrace, the setting for the gothic soap-opera, Dark Shadows, where a door handle is said to have turned on its own and seemingly inexplicable footsteps and banging have been heard.

TAPS visits the Reed Homestead of Townsend, Massachusetts, where sightings of a ghostly grieving mother are reported. Next, they investigate stories of an apparition of a Confederate soldier at Summerseat Farm in Maryland.
TAPS investigates a site that once held violent riots between a legendary capitalist and the steel workers.
TAPS investigates Hawaii's Plantation Village in Waipahu, where sightings of a ghostly girl and possibly haunted artifacts are reported. Later, the team visits Ventfort Hall in Lenox, Massachusetts.

Jason along with daughter Haily, visit a house to investigate child ghosts who occasionally bounce balls and are heard walking back and forth on the third floor. Jason allows Haily to take the lead on her first investigation, as he believes that child ghosts are more apt to make contact with younger females. The group just might have thought correctly after Haily hears whispering voices.
The TAPS team is the first paranormal team to ever investigate the famed Friar's Club in New York City. Next, the team travels to the Main Street Armory in Rochester, New York.
Ghost Hunters, the team heads to Rapids Theater in Niagara Falls, New York where a lonely actress hanged herself backstage. The staff believes her spirit has never left and is haunting the theater.

Special guest investigator Meredith Vieira joins the TAPS team, as they investigate Sailors' Snug Harbor in Staten Island, New York. Once a retirement home to weathered seaman, it's now home to the spirit of a murdered matron.

TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri, to investigate the notorious Missouri State Penitentiary. A prison that was once named one of the most violent prisons in America. Riots, stabbings and executions left thousands dead over the years -- resulting in an abandoned prison full of ghostly inmates.

Friends and Heroes is an animated children's adventure based in Ancient Egypt, Israel and Rome. The story follows two young friends Macky and Portia as they fight for justice against the Roman Empire.
Hillsong Kids has your favourite worship music for children and fun faith-based videos produced by the creative team behind Hillsong Kids Praise and Worship ...

Join kid-hosts Myles and Stella for a fun, non-stop musical playlist of hit songs about Faith and Trust! Bible-based songs and scripture songs make up this God Rocks Playlist, an MTV style music program targeting kids 5-12. The series features high quality, original songs from the award-winning God Rocks! band as well as other musical characters from the God Rocks universe.

Welcome to the wonderful world of Brightington, home of Hunter and Twerp, Scripture Seekers! Stacks of fun Bible lessons for children to enjoy. Every episode brings new challenges to overcome and new lessons to learn, such as why do we pray? What/who is the Holy Spirit? Why is the Bible important? How can we recognise the voice of God and avoid nonsense teaching? Challenging and powerful lessons are introduced in the context of wacky comedy adventures that children will love so much, they won't even realise they're learning!

Cypher and Bibleman are going to jail!? Oh, they’re visiting some young men at a juvenile detention centre. And the little brother of one of the inmates wants to meet Bibleman, so Pastor Lewis is taking Logan there on Bible study day.

David is not happy having a new babysitter. David and Carter decide to behave badly. The new babysitter exhibits the Fruit of patience and kindness and they all enjoy a huge banana split together as a peace offering.

Whirl is a Bible-based cartoon series about the loveable, sometimes overly-enthusiastic kids of First Second Church. In each episode, the kids tackle a different theme that is central to Christian values. Everything from generosity and forgiveness to doubt and the trinity are explored over the course of the series. And while the issues dealt with in each episode are relatable, the solutions this kooky cast often find are a bit… unconventional. Whether the kids of First Second Church are searching for a hidden sanctum of the church's altar guild, or trying to outsmart robots bent on world domination, these characters will keep the whole family laughing and learning.

Join Pastor Doug, Dusty, Amelia and all the characters as they learn about the Bible and how it applies to daily life. Games, songs, and some silly puppets will inspire kids to follow along and get into God's Word!

This quirky kids show introduces children to classic stories from the Old Testament using finger puppets. The Deditos series is produced in Guatemala by a multicultural team, it has a distinct international flavour which is ideal for children all around the world.

Join Kyle, Lyds, Extra Bear, and Stu as they share with you some cool vids, catchy catch phrases crazy challenges, things you can do in 3 minutes, and other random stuff to make your life awesome. It’s the Blello Show! Let’s go!

The familiar and the futuristic interact with ancient people, places and events to create a sense of wonder, anticipation, empowerment, and personal breakthrough as the children witness God's interaction with man. Superbook is always an exciting journey, full of discovery - with a transformational outcome. Superbook teaches children timeless moral truths and life lessons through the captivating, Bible-based adventures of two time-traveling children and their robot friend. Play fun Superbook games here: https://us-en.superbook.cbn.com/games
Ryan Defrates: Secret Agent is about a young, reckless spy paired with his mum—her wisdom and kindness always saves the day.

Influence. Everyone wants it; everyone has it; but only few can wield it on the level that Joan of Arc did. Learn how she went from a nobody from nowhere to becoming the original influencer all the while changing the course of Europe forever.

Dominating the landscape for centuries, ancient cathedrals and abbeys reflect Britain's turbulent history through their architectural grandeur. A Pilgrimage through Britain's Great Cathedrals explores cathedrals and abbeys found throughout England and Wales, featuring interviews with historians and experts and breathtaking footage of the cathedrals’ legendary facades and soaring interior spaces.

It’s challenging enough to combine two people into one relationship, but adding the ingredient of kids can make a recipe for relationship stress! Blended and step families make up around 1 in 10 families. They face unique challenges that often lead to conflict, but with a little patience and a lot of love, a blended family can also experience a strength that’s only found at the other side of great challenge. For Rachel, having three children to take care of meant she didn't want the complexities of a new relationship. So when an old friendship with Steven grew to something more, communication was vital to navigate the next steps of blending a family.

Chef Craig explores the flavors of Croatia and Barbados as he prepares several dishes, including snapper with curried pumpkin, oxtail pasticada served with a truffle sauce, two different shrimp meals, and monkfish served with ham.

The host explores the flavors of Madagascar and Belgium as he prepares Belgian beer-steamed mussels salad, waffle-cut fries and potato-leek mousse, steak Madagascar, pancakes made with rice flour and coconut, and stir fry with shellfish.

Chef Craig Wong explores the flavors of Peru and Lebanon by preparing swordfish with pureed sweet potatoes, lamb neck slow poached in olive oil, grilled flank steak, hasselback batata harra, and squab prepared with several flavors.

As the host explores various dishes from South Africa and Portugal, he prepares ostrich steak served with Cape gooseberries, monkey gland sauce, peri peri chicken, and grilled veal chop served with a sweet-tart tropical fruit salad.
Host Amanda Herrera shows us why fresh is always best with two creative dishes using ingredients from the farmers' market.
Zestful cook Amanda Herrera scoops up raspberries, peas, mint, and apricots to use in three summer recipes.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Al Roker and his daughter Courtney Roker Laga’s cookbook Al Roker’s Recipes to Live By! Follow along as Shahir prepares chicken shawarma bowls, Maryland-style crab cakes, and a spectacular chili!
The Italian region Campania is known for its seafood and pizza. Famed Chef Michael Bonacini prepares classics like Margherita Pizza and Fried Seafood.

Maddie and Kiki are bringing bold flavours and creative BBQ twists to the barn with a menu packed with colour and spice. They toss a grilled corn salad, stuff smoky poblano peppers with Oaxaca cheese, fire up lamb steaks with mango mint chutney, and bake orange peel cinnamon buns.

Maddie and Kiki bring a taste of the coast to the barn with a BBQ feast full of fresh seafood and comforting sides. They grill oysters topped with serrano ham, fill avocados with crab, fire up lobster tails with basil mayo, and serve green bean salad with creamy BBQ scalloped potatoes.

Italian chef and food guru Vanessa Gianfrancesco teaches us how to make fresh pasta like an Italian, and then uses that pasta to create everything from fettucine alfredo to tortelloni to lasagna bianca.

After selecting olives and onions as his special ingredients, the chef uses caramelized onions to prepare a batch of French onion soup before then creating a Moroccan-inspired chicken dish that uses olives to create a tart flavor.
Nothing says comfort food better than fried chicken. Chef Spencer Watts shows us all the fixings for a fast, easy, and delicious fried chicken night.
Award-winning chef Natalia Machado from Argentina makes palm heart and shrimp salad, beef stew in a pumpkin, roasted pork spare ribs with a delicious marinade, and addictive dulce de leche ice cream.
Baking host Jessica McGovern warms up the kitchen with some melty, creamy, and chewy treats to comfort you on a rainy day.
Watch a child haunt an officer; meet the spirit behind a series of accidents.
Respond to a home invasion with officer Jen and chase bloody footprints from a vanishing spirit. Meet a ghostly mum and baby with military guard Dan, and see a spirit attack paramedic Ryleigh.
Examine evidence of a satanic sacrifice and pursue a bloodthirsty ghost doctor.
See what happens when two women are visited by the ghosts of hospital patients.
Witness two ghostly encounters that inspire artistic insight and prowess.
Grapple with a tormented soul and face a deserted hospital's resident demon.

Paramedic Ryleigh hunts a red-eyed dog demon and phantom master in an abandoned animal-testing lab. EMT Bret faces a satanic scene at a lonely farm, and officer Marco meets a dead mobster haunting his police station.

Inspect prison guard Bill’s scars from a brutal attack by the spirit of a long-dead prisoner. Revisit a terrifying nursing home haunting with rookie cop Anthony, and hear the spiritual words EMT Jose used to release the soul of a troubled apparition.

Experience corrections officer Alex’s encounter with the dark energy of a deceased prisoner seemingly bent on revenge. Probe a puzzling case with EMT Cory, whose patient seemed normal but died after an evil shadow rampaged through his room.
Officer Collins encounters paranormal activity at a penitentiary. Firefighter Hernandez sees a ghost in photos, sparking poltergeist chaos. Paramedic Chris finds a suicidal man's spirit in a motel.
Rookie EMT Kat meets the ghost of an elderly patient who carked it earlier in her shift at an isolated ambulance station. Firey Keith reckons he saved a bloke by talking his soul back into his body.
Deborah is disturbed when her critically injured boyfriend tries to break into the morgue. Plus, paranormal activity hits the dialysis clinic.
Big scares come in small packages—a ghostly girl follows a care-home housekeeper, disembodied footsteps trail a hospital balloon, and a pint-sized angel of death appears.
Nurses' aide Emily senses a foreboding presence stalking the hallway of a care facility. Nurse Kaitlyn notices not all residents move on after death.
Cross paths with lingering souls—a nurse believes cold spots are a stuck patient's spirit, trauma binds the dead to the living, and a ghost can't exit a hospital café.

The contestants’ speculations prove correct when Chef Ramsay combines all of them into one team. The final five proudly change into their black jackets in preparation for a test which Chef Ramsay gives regularly to prospective employees. The finalists have ten ingredients and 20 minutes to create a unique dish. Keith is beside himself with excitement when Chef Ramsay reveals that the winner will join him in Las Vegas for a tour of the prize restaurant space. All the chefs impress with Keith and Virginia's dishes standing out. In the dinner service the kitchen gets off to a poor start. In spite of problems the finalists manage to complete the service, but one contestant is in trouble over raw chicken - it is not only inexcusable it's potentially deadly.
Gordon Ramsay's culinary boot camp in the USA challenges more aspiring chefs.
The contestants taste Chef Ramsay's signature dish and are given twenty minutes to replicate it. Tensions rise amongst the chefs amidst accusations of cheating.
The second series winner of Hell's Kitchen USA is decided.

Chef Ramsey offers 15 new contestants the chance to become the executive chef at his new restaurant, but things don't start off well as one hopeful's dish makes Gordon physically ill and another contestant is absent for the dinner service.
The season's first challenge finds the contestants slicing halibut into thin six-ounce fillets. One member of each team must serve as maître d' during the dining service.

Starting with live chickens in their sleeping quarters, the teams must pluck and clean the birds perfectly before serving them family style at dinner; the winning team takes some time off while the losers take to the fields to pick peppers.

The red and blue teams prepare pasta for the evening dinner service, and the team with the highest output earns a day at the Santa Monica Pier; one team's chances are jeopardized when an accident in the kitchen sends a contestant to the hospital.
The first challenge for the remaining eleven chefs: make a gourmet pizza. The winners enjoy gourmet burgers in Santa Barbara while the losers prepare for the night's dinner service.

When a picky 16-year-old comes to Hell’s Kitchen for her fantasy birthday bash, the chefs find themselves catering to one of their toughest critics yet...teenagers. The two teams must call on their inner-adolescent to design a teen-pleasing menu for the girl’s special day.
Chef Ramsay makes the nine remaining chefs take a blindfolded taste test. The winners get to go to a spa; the losers must clean the dorm.

p.d: For Tasmanian devils, dominance is the name of the game during mating season. Meet males who fight for the right to pass on their genes, and learn about the violent, noisy etiquette of these carnivorous marsupials' mealtime.

p.t: Secret Life of the Tasmanian Devil
p.d: Tasmanian Devils might have the most infamous reputations of any of the country's marsupials, but these spirited scrappers also have another side. They're committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young.

Live through a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. See how the sun affects the movement, feeding habits, and mating rituals of everything from tiny zooplankton to whale sharks.

Celebrate the first day of spring with Aussie creatures looking for either a dinner or a date. From the kangaroos in the grasslands to the koalas in the trees to the freshwater crocodiles, they hunt for food or fight for breeding rights.

Meet the unique primates and reptiles searching for water and dodging predators, from ring-tailed lemurs in the east coast rainforests to tiny brown leaf chameleons, in this land of extreme climate variations and habitats.

Visit one of the most arid and hottest parts of the world to discover how dhub lizards and dromedary camels adapted to withstand the intense conditions. Then move into the more moderate southern mountains, where rare hyrax and chameleons forage.

Africa is a continent filled with unique and extraordinary creatures whose lives are shaped by millions of years of evolution. Africa is also the birthplace of humankind. We traveled alongside the continent's animals on our own journey of evolution, yet intelligence took us on a very different path. Our curiosity led to questions about the world around us which were answered through stories, myths and legends.

Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

Trek to the planet's quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.
Dr. Brown rushes to save a policeman's pet after it was poisoned with snail bait; a malnourished penguin washes up on Bondi Beach and is brought to the clinic.

Witness a shocking act of cruelty when the vets take on a 12-year-old cat deliberately left to die in the Bondi surf. Meet a depressed parrot caught up in a bizarre love triangle and watch Lisa help a Samoyed survive a killer tick bite.

Take a lesson in responsible canine ownership when the Atkinson family taps Beverley to help them bring home a brand new puppy. Learn if a Brussels griffon, a sheltie, or a toy Manchester terrier will be the best teacher for their three kids.

Feel the love as a little boy searches for a canine buddy he can call his own. Join the Bhattis and Beverley as they scope out cairn terriers, Dutch sheepdogs, and Yorkie-poos to see which furry bundle of joy will make a permanent connection.

Welcome back hope and joy with the Pascoe family, who are still grieving the recent passing of their first family pooch. Head out with Beverley to see if an Australian shepherd, a golden retriever, or a vizsla will mend their broken hearts.

Follow Beverley as she plays matchmaker to the Haggiths’ beloved family dog, who’s looking for a new BFF. Meet mixed-breed rescue pups Benny, Gibson, and Baron, and see which of these pint-sized pals finally gets the loving home they deserve.
Megan swallows her pride and asks for her job back at Wendigo Farms. Tammy's hot young date shows up at the barn uninvited. Allie briefs Mike on a drastic strategy for winning Tammy back.

Celebrate as Allie cashes in on a horse while Tammy shocks the barn by announcing her wedding is next weekend. Join a whirlwind dress-shopping spree and watch Megan take over Allie's lesson with Courtney—with less than stellar results.
There were always going to be days like this. Watch as an attempt to save the damaged tail of a puppy, a high-tech eye operation, and a dramatic birth push Dr. Scott to the limit.

Follow Dr. Scott as he performs a risky procedure to save a 14-year-old family dog, then travels to a working farm in the heart of London. Back home, a French bulldog pup suffers from a mystery disease.
A three-legged Labrador has an issue; Scott tries to determine why a two-year-old patient is walking like a senior animal; a chubby hedgehog begins a fitness routine.

Winter has arrived but work continues apace at Hope for Wildlife. Look on as Hope rallies her team to release a herd of white-tailed deer that has been under her care. Investigate the possible causes of a mysterious influx of snowy owls to the rehab.

Explore the urban jungle with Hope, who is on a mission to learn more about wildlife behaviour in a giant metropolis. Grab a flashlight and prowl moonlit city streets as she searches for a mysterious nocturnal predator.

When Hope suddenly sustains an injury, life at the rehabilitation center must continue as normal without her being there; an artist draws inspiration from Hope for Wildlife; an owl receives a malevolent welcome back to the wildlife.

Get a first impression of Courtney, the new boarder, as Tammy and Allie grapple with managing the barn now that Megan has resigned. Tag along with Megan, who visits a friend in Alberta looking for greener pastures and a fresh start.

Brian and Jon investigate whether two arrow-themed myths fly straight and true. Can a flaming arrow fired into a car's gas tank cause it to erupt in flames?

This episode of MythBusters is a game of two halves: Kari, Grant and Tory investigate a world-famous myth from American history, while Adam and Jamie probe some rather unpleasant facts about flatulence.

Adam and Jamie reveal their favourite shopping haunts. Tune in for a comprehensive alternative shoppers guide as the Mythbusters show how they procure the weird and wonderful array of stuff they have used in the making of the show.
On this blisteringly cold episode of Mythbusters, the team gets some northern exposure as they pack up their sleds, their brass monkeys and their ingenuity for Alaska Special, The Return.
The MythBusters explore Newtonian propulsion. Can you move through syrup as efficiently as water, and can a sailboat be powered by blowing on its own sail?
Adam and Jamie reinvent the wheel, quite literally. In Flaming Reel, Kari, Tory and Grant have got a myth that’s definitely labelled “something fishy”.
Will a toilet filled with bug spray explode? If not, what does it take to make a toilet explode in the manner described in this popular myth?
Can cell phones cause dangerous gas station fires? Can a change in atmospheric pressure, experienced while flying have an effect on breast implants? And can CDs shatter in very high-speed drives?
Jamie and Adam recreate a widely known construction industry myth. Plus, can peeing on the third subway rail lead to electrocution? And can an eel skin wallet demagnetise credit cards?
The Myth: that a penny dropped from the top of the Empire State Building will be embedded in the concrete or asphalt below. If it strikes a poor pedestrian, it will shatter their skull and kill them.

Throughout history stories have been told of exhumed bodies and coffins that showed apparent signs of life after burial - like scratch marks on faces and inside coffin lids as the interred desperately tried to escape.

Mikey was challenged by his friends to eat six packs of POP Rocks Candy and Six cans of Soda. The carbon dioxide that makes the candy pop combined with the carbon dioxide in the soda to create so much pressure his stomach exploded.
Does wearing a tongue stud increase your chances of being struck by lightning? Can you build a a cannon out of a tree? And Adam and Jamie set out to bust the myth that you can fool the breathalyser.
Find out how science is ensuring a sustainable future for this vital ecosystem.
The wetland landscapes of southern Africa are home to a rich tapestry of life.This is usually a land of plenty but for the last 20 years, the St Lucia area has received below average rainfall.
The magnificent jaguar is the largest cat in all of the Americas. In Brazil, it reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.
In the Pantanal, the wonderful ocelot appears to be making a comeback. A team of scientists try to figure out the clues to its resurgence.
The white-whiskered spider monkey is one of the most intelligent and agile creatures in the New World, and dwells happily within a protected Brazilian forest.
Finding a home in new territory is a challenge, but sometimes, animals have no choice. Using sheer numbers to impose their will, these are nature's unwanted guests.

Off the southern coast of Australia, Western grey kangaroos thrive on the predator-free Kangaroo Island, aptly named for its unique inhabitants. To the south lies Phillip Island, a sanctuary for the world's smallest penguin species. Embark on a journey to discover some of nature's most hospitable havens for animals.
Some species simply can't survive in one place. Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys, and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives for many animals.
In the rivers of Nova Scotia, two species of fish swim upstream to their ancestral home, while a colony of double-crested cormorants thrive on the Pictou River.
The future of African wildlife comes down to a simple equation: the more people, the less wildlife.

This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africa’s wilderness.

Considered to be the most beautiful of the Cape’s protected areas, Kogelberg Nature Reserve has experienced minimal human interference. Discover the spectacular land and sea life flourishing in this unique botanical wonderland.

Join guide Jean du Plessis for his first summit attempt on Mt. Kilimanjaro to see whether climate change has eroded its snowy peak. Learn about the pinnacle’s five climatic zones and search for clues that its volcanic heart is rumbling back to life.

Wildlife expert and safari guide Jean Du Plessis treks out to Mahale Mountains National Park, hoping to spend some time with the wild chimps living in the scrub of this remote and protected neck of the woods in Tanzania.
Watch mighty hippos and Nile crocodiles battle for survival in the place they both call home.

Having found the location of the warrior base, Carter is assigned a recon mission to determine Anubis's plans. Meanwhile, O'Neill mounts a mission to South America to rescue Daniel who has been kidnapped by Honduran rebels demanding a ransom.

While on a routine journey, the Prometheus is attacked by an alien ship and is forced to enter a mysterious interstellar cloud; Dr. Carter awakens to find herself alone on the Prometheus and begins to suffer from hallucinations.
Jonas Quinn returns with news that Naquadria mines of Kelowna will cause an explosion in the planet's core.

Daniel experiences strange dreams centered around his possible knowledge of the Lost City of the Ancients. Suspicious that Daniel's mind is being manipulated, the team must find a way to help him while keeping the secret from the Goa'uld.
When the Beta Site is attacked by Anubis's drones, Carter and Jacob get their first chance to test a new weapon. Jacob is injured and Carter goes MIA.

SG-1 SG-3 and SG-5 gate to the address where they find the nomadic tribe and Daniel Jackson. But Daniel doesn't remember O'Neill Carter or Teal'c and he's not sure he wants to remember who he is because he feels he might have done something wrong. Carter convinces Daniel that he was a very good person and to return to SG-1. The team theorizes that Daniel was expelled from the race of Ascended beings by his benefactor Oma after he interfered in human affairs on Abydos.
A documentary crew is given a true look at the heroic nature and family-like bond of the soldiers of the SGC.

Agent Barrett of the NID calls SG-1 to Los Angeles to consult on a mass murder of a rogue sleeper cell by a woman. There they find many Goa'uld artifacts relating to Sekhmet, a subordinate of Ra. How this operation relates to the Goa'uld eludes SG-1.

The race begins. After Warrick and co-pilot Carter evade the obstacle course's attack drones they move on to Stage Two in which the racers head into the coronasphere of Hebridan's sun. Then an explosion occurs: The ship's power diverter has been sabotaged and overloaded. The Seberus is heading into the sun. Their only hope is to relocate the Naquadah generator bypass the diverter and supply power directly to the engines.

O'Neill allows the knowledge of the Ancients to be downloaded into his mind again, even though the first time almost killed him. While he slowly deteriorates, he and SG-1 must race against time to uncover the secret of the Lost City of the Ancients.
When Anubis attacks Earth, General Hammond launches an offensive. Meanwhile, the search for the lost city continues and Jack's health deteriorates.

Carter and Teal'c are in search of the Asgard, trying to save Colonel O'Neill, but they're about to make a horrifying discovery: the Asgard's most deadly enemy has returned with a vengeance. Meanwhile, the System Lords seek an alliance with Earth against a common enemy.
While the Goa'uld threaten to attack Earth, SG-1 and the Asgard make a last, desperate stand against the Replicators, who have caught Major Carter.

When Jackson contracts a mysterious illness, O'Neill is convinced that a contagion has infected the base and orders a lockdown. But when Jackson reveals that he was actually possessed by Anubis, O'Neill must discover the identity of the new host!
General O'Neill tries to settle into his new job, but faces never-ending crises - including the capture of SG-1 by the Goa'uld.

In one of the toughest seasons in Wicked Tuna history when finding the fish and making a paycheck is harder than ever, can the next generation of Gloucester fishermen rise up to the challenge, battling one obstacle after another? Can these young guns of the Bluefin fishery step up their game and prove their worth by bringing home blue gold?
Hot Tuna gets help from Bad Fish to help increase profits by catching Bluefin for their family business and move out of the middle of the pack.

As the clock keeps ticking on the toughest season yet, Gloucester’s best captains must rely on their mates to help them land Bluefin in an uncertain market. But while some crews find strength in numbers, others find themselves shorthanded. And as the pressure mounts, these mates are forced to push themselves harder than ever as they fight to land blue gold and end up on top.

In a season already weighed down by less fishing days and lower prices, the fleet faces one more obstacle beyond their control: the bite slowing down. As the waters warm during summer, the Bluefin spread out, but now they’re nowhere to be found and the clock is ticking. With three days to land a paycheck, the fleet fishes from Maine all the way down to Cape Cod Bay, and the pressure to catch pushes captains to rethink their strategies.

In their 10th season as competitors, the Gloucester captains face an unprecedented challenge: making a living in a bluefin market that's struggling to rebound. The resilient fleet decides to work together OBX-style to help each other catch. The 5 original boats are joined by a familiar mix of recent captains and a tuna legend, whose skills immediately puts the entire fleet on notice.
Captain Dave Marciano defies the fleet by fishing in a secret location on his own.
Five-time champion Dave Carraro suffers from the longest cold streak of his career.

With the quota running out and the end in sight, the captains gamble on where to fish to catch quality bluefin and earn big paychecks but they can't control what bites. Every jumbo tuna they land takes a giant bite out of the quota.
A mechanical delay keeps Wicked Pissah at the dock, and the fleet tries to launch ahead.
With the quota almost caught, the fleet fights to gain ground in a fierce competition.

From limited fishing days to lower prices and with only one buyer break left, Hard Merchandise is out to prove they deserve another win after so many bad seasons, but Paul and his crew will do anything to have a shot at the title on Wicked Pissah.
Bluefin season in Gloucester is open and the fleet is ready to bounce back from last year's low prices and cash in on a brighter future.

The fleet’s livelihood is on the line as they attempt to control what bites their hook. Pinwheel fights to stay ahead after captain Tyler McLaughlin discovers a mechanical issue on the boat. Tyler and his mate Marissa work together to try and control the chaos in order to catch. Meanwhile, struggling for their first tuna of the season, Dot Com takes an unusual gamble and chases the bite, while the rest of the fleet battle to get ahead.

In a fleet filled with champions, the pressure is on for previous winners to reclaim their titles. Hard Merch is seeking redemption for coming in second last season, while Fat Tuna battles to take the top spot away from Pinwheel. Meanwhile, last season’s winner, Wicked Pissah, struggles to catch their first fish, and defend their title.
